module: Flowgraph node "Simple Planet" (category once_p_duration). Creates a spherical gravity source for a vehicle by sending obj:setPlanets({x,y,z,radius,mass}) to its VM. Input pins: vehId (default: player vehicle 0), position (vec3), radius, mass. Executed only once; the node reset or the graph stop empties the planets (obj:setPlanets({})).
notes: If position, mass or radius is nil, the node does nothing.
If vehId matches no object, self.vehicle is nil and queueLuaCommand crashes (unprotected).
Old pin vehID renamed vehId (legacyPins). The description of the vehId pin talks about gravity but it designates the target vehicle.

onNodeReset.desc: If a vehicle was targeted, sends it obj:setPlanets({}) and forgets the reference.

workOnce.desc: Builds the command obj:setPlanets({x,y,z,radius,mass}) and sends it to the targeted vehicle.
